cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa and the puppy Max. Times of day show the light and what the family is doing; days and months each get their own activity or season so they look different.

words.en: We play in the park in the afternoon.
words.scene: Lily and Tom playing on the swings in a sunny park in the afternoon, long soft shadows on the grass.
more: Grandpa has a rest every afternoon.
爷爷每天下午都休息一会儿。

words.en: School starts at 9 a.m.
words.scene: Lily walking to school along a bright morning street with her bag on her back, the low morning sun behind the houses and no shadows yet.
more: 我们上午十一点上数学课。

words.en: Dinner is at 6 p.m.
words.scene: The family sitting down at the dinner table in a warm kitchen in the evening, plates of food in front of them, the window showing a dark orange sky.
more: We watch a film at 3 p.m.

words.en: It's three o'clock.
words.scene: A big round wall clock in a kitchen with the long hand straight up at the top and the short hand pointing straight to the right, Lily looking up at it.
more: Tom goes to bed at eight o'clock.
The film starts at seven o'clock.

words.en: The clock says eight o'clock.
more: There is a clock in the kitchen.

words.en: The film is two hours long.
words.sz: 这部电影有两个小时长。
words.scene: Lily and Tom sitting on the sofa watching television in the evening, a big hour-glass with sand running down standing on the table beside them.
more: We have an hour for lunch.

words.en: Wait a minute, please!
words.scene: Tom putting on his shoes by the front door while Lily waits holding her bag, a small egg timer ticking on the hall table.
more: Our lessons are forty minutes long.
I can swim fifty metres in one minute.

words.en: One, two, three: that is three seconds!
words.scene: Tom holding his nose and sinking under the water of a swimming pool, his big sister Lily counting on her fingers at the side of the pool.
more: Max runs ten metres in two seconds.
senses: Lily is second in the race.

words.en: Lily is second in the race.
words.scene: Three children on a winners' podium after a running race: Mia on the highest middle step with a gold medal, Lily on the slightly lower step beside her with a silver medal, Sam on the lowest step.
more: Sam is second in our class.

words.en: I eat half an apple.
words.scene: One red apple cut into two equal halves on a plate, half of it still in Lily's hand.
more: Tom gets up at half past six.
Tom eats half of the cake.

words.en: It's half past three.
words.scene: A round wall clock with the long hand pointing straight down and the short hand halfway between two numbers, Lily looking up at it from her homework.
senses: In the past, people had no cars.

words.en: What time is it?
words.scene: Lily standing on tiptoe to look at the big clock in the school hall, Tom waiting beside her with his bag on his back.
more: I go swimming three times a week.
senses: I go swimming three times a week.

words.en: The house is quiet at midnight.
words.scene: A dark bedroom at night with a full moon high in the black sky outside the window, a clock on the table with both hands straight up, Lily fast asleep in her bed.
more: Lily wakes up at midnight and drinks some water.
Lily 半夜醒来，喝了点水。

words.en: We eat lunch at noon.
words.sz: 我们中午十二点吃午饭。
words.scene: Lily and Tom sitting at a table with plates of soup outside on a bright lawn at noon, the sun straight up in the sky and short shadows under the table.
more: The sun is high at noon.

words.en: I get up in the morning.
words.scene: Lily stretching in her bed in pyjamas as soft morning light comes through the window, birds outside, her school bag on the chair.

words.en: We watch television in the evening.
words.scene: The family together on the sofa in the living room in the evening, the window showing a soft orange sky, the television glowing in front of them.
more: Dad walks the dog in the evening.

words.en: Lily sleeps at night.
words.scene: Lily asleep in her bed at night, the moon and many stars outside the window, Max sleeping on a blanket at the foot of the bed.
more: The stars come out at night.

words.en: We go to school every day.
words.scene: A bright daytime sky with a big sun over a small school building, children with bags walking through the gate.
more: There are seven days in a week.

words.en: We have maths today.
words.scene: Lily in her sports kit running on a sunny school sports field today, her class behind her, the sun high up.

words.en: We visit Grandma tomorrow.
words.scene: Lily packing her bag for a trip the next day, clothes and a toothbrush laid out on her bed, Mum folding a jumper beside her.
more: Is it going to rain tomorrow?

words.en: We watch a film tonight.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max sitting on the sofa under a blanket in their own living room this evening, popcorn in a big bowl, the screen glowing in front of them.

words.en: It was Lily's party yesterday.
words.sz: 昨天是 Lily 的聚会。
words.scene: Lily sitting on her bed looking at a photo of a birthday party from the day before, her puppy Max beside her, the room lit by soft afternoon light.
more: We were at the zoo yesterday.
Tom was sad yesterday, but he is happy now.
Tom 昨天不开心，但现在开心了。

words.en: School starts on Monday.
words.scene: A bright Monday morning in the classroom: Lily putting her school bag down by her desk while the other children sit down, a big round clock on the wall behind her.

words.en: Lily has art on Tuesday.
words.scene: Lily painting a picture of a fish at a school table on a Tuesday afternoon, a jar of brushes and an open pot of red paint beside her, paint on her fingers.
more: We go to the library on Tuesday.

words.en: We have swimming on Wednesday.
words.scene: Children in swimming costumes at the side of a pool on a Wednesday lesson, one child jumping in with a big splash, the coach clapping on the wet floor.

words.en: We bake a cake on Thursday.
words.scene: Mum and Lily at the kitchen table on a Thursday afternoon mixing cake in a big bowl, Tom stirring with a wooden spoon, soft flour dust in the air.
more: Tom has a piano lesson on Thursday.
Tom 星期四有一节钢琴课。
星期四是去图书馆的日子。

words.en: Sam plays football on Friday.
words.scene: Children playing football on the school field on a Friday afternoon, Sam kicking a black and white ball towards the goal, long shadows across the grass.
more: We watch a film at home on Friday.
我们星期五在家看电影。

words.en: We go cycling on Saturday.
words.sz: 我们星期六去骑自行车。
words.scene: The family cycling along a river path on a Saturday morning, Lily in front on her bike, Tom on his small bike beside Mum, Dad behind them and Max running happily.
more: I do my homework on Saturday.
Sometimes we visit Grandma on Saturday.
有时候我们星期六去看奶奶。

words.en: We go to the zoo on Sunday.
words.scene: Lily and Tom on their father's shoulders looking over a low wall at two elephants in the sun at the zoo on Sunday, the children each holding an ice cream.
more: We go to bed early on Sunday.

words.en: Mum works five days a week.
words.scene: Lily standing in front of a kitchen wall calendar that shows one row of seven big squares, each square with a small picture: a school bag, a paintbrush, a swimming pool, a cake, a football, a bike and a sun; she points at the row.
more: This week we are in London.
We play in the park once a week.
我们一周去公园玩一次。

words.en: Lily walks to school every weekday.
words.sz: Lily 每个工作日都走路去上学。
words.scene: Lily walking to school with her school bag on a busy weekday morning.
more: Mum drives to work on a weekday.
妈妈工作日开车去上班。
Saturday and Sunday are not weekdays.
星期六和星期天不是工作日。

words.en: We get up late at the weekend.
words.scene: The whole family still in pyjamas having a slow breakfast in the kitchen on a sunny weekend morning, Tom rubbing his eyes, pancakes on the table and Max at their feet.
more: We visit Grandma at the weekend.
The shop is very busy at the weekend.

words.en: Lily goes to a weekly football club.
words.sz: Lily 每周参加一次足球小组。
words.scene: Three small pictures one under another showing the same children at the same football club on the same day of the week: Lily arriving on the wet grass, the team playing, Lily waving goodbye; no writing anywhere.
more: Our class has a weekly test.
我们班每周有一次小测验。
奶奶每周都给我们打电话。

words.en: Max has a daily walk.
words.scene: Four small pictures in a row showing the same walk: Lily and Max on the lead at the same garden gate in bright sunshine, in the rain, in the snow and with autumn leaves blowing; no writing anywhere.
more: Dad has a daily walk after dinner.
爸爸晚饭后每天都散一次步。

words.en: We visit Grandma once a month.
words.sz: 我们一个月去看一次奶奶。
words.scene: A row of five small pictures of the same moon seen from Lily's bedroom window at night, from a thin crescent to a round full moon and back again; no writing anywhere.
more: Lily reads five books a month.
There are twelve months in a year.

words.en: Our class has a monthly trip.
words.sz: 我们班每月有一次外出参观。
words.scene: Lily waving from the window of a big school bus leaving the school gate, her classmates inside with their bags, a small museum building on a hill in the distance; no writing anywhere.
more: Mum buys a monthly magazine for Grandma.
妈妈每月给奶奶买一本杂志。
美术小组每月聚会一次。

words.en: Lily is nine years old this year.
words.scene: Lily standing with her back against the kitchen door frame while Mum marks her height on the frame with a pencil, a small birthday cake with one candle on the table beside them.
more: Tom will be seven years old next year.
We have a big party once a year.
我们一年开一次大聚会。

words.en: This castle is more than a century old.
words.sz: 这座城堡有一百多年的历史了。
words.scene: a very old stone castle next to a modern glass building, showing a long time.
more: This shop is a century old.
这家商店有一个世纪的历史了。
A century has one hundred years.

words.en: Wait a moment, please.
words.scene: Mum on the phone holding up one finger to Tom, asking him to wait.
more: Mum is busy at the moment.
Dad has a rest for a moment in the garden.
爸爸在花园里休息一会儿。

words.en: Mum puts a new calendar on the wall.
words.sz: 妈妈在墙上挂了一本新年历。
words.scene: Mum on a small step ladder hanging a big paper calendar on the kitchen wall while Lily holds it straight at the bottom; its grid of day-boxes is empty, with one box marked by a small sun, no readable writing.
more: There is a calendar in the kitchen.
Mum looks at the calendar every day.

words.en: What's the date today?
words.scene: Lily pointing at a big wall calendar with one day circled in red, no readable writing.
more: Mum writes the date on the card.
妈妈把日期写在卡片上。
Lily knows the date of Grandma's birthday.
Lily 知道奶奶生日的日期。

words.en: Lily writes in her diary every evening.
words.sz: Lily 每天晚上都写日记。
words.scene: Lily sitting at her desk by the window in the soft afternoon light, writing in a small open book with a pencil, one red ribbon lying beside it; no readable writing on the page.
more: Dad keeps a diary about the weather.
Lily's diary is under her pillow.
Lily 的日记本在她的枕头下面。

words.en: It is cold and dark in January.
words.scene: A freezing January morning: thick white frost on the garden grass and a small frozen pond, bare trees, Lily at the garden door pulling on her scarf with her breath making a little white cloud, Tom holding an ice cube in his glove.

words.en: It is windy and wet in February.
words.scene: A grey February sky over a wet garden: strong wind blowing bare branches, puddles on the path, Lily in a yellow raincoat and boots holding her umbrella inside out, Tom jumping in a puddle.

words.en: In March, the first flowers come out.
words.scene: A cool early-spring March garden: green shoots and a few small white and yellow flowers in the grass, bare trees still without leaves, Lily kneeling to water a little plant, Tom beside her holding a small bag of seeds.
more: We fly kites in the park in March.
我们三月在公园里放风筝。
Mum cuts her hair in March.

words.en: It often rains in April.
words.scene: A showery April day in the park: rain falling through pale sun with a small rainbow, blossom on the trees, Lily and Tom in boots and coats each holding an umbrella, Max shaking water off his fur.
more: Lily wears her raincoat in April.
The ducks play in the rain in April.

words.en: We pick strawberries in May.
words.scene: A warm, sunny May garden full of flowers: Lily picking strawberries from a low plant in a green basket, Tom handing her a big red one, pink roses and a butterfly behind them.
more: The apple trees are pink in May.
苹果树五月开粉色的花。
Our class goes to the farm in May.

words.en: May I come in?
words.scene: Tom standing in the doorway of a bright classroom, one hand on the door, asking to come in, the teacher at the front smiling and waving him in, the other children at their desks.
more: May I have some water, please?

words.en: We swim in the lake in June.
words.scene: A long bright June evening by a calm blue lake: Lily and Dad swimming with red armbands, towels on the warm grass, Mum sitting on a picnic blanket with three drinks, the sun still high above the trees.
more: June is the start of summer.
Tom has his swimming lesson in June.

words.en: The summer holidays start in July.
words.scene: A very hot July day at a busy beach: a big yellow sun, sandcastles and colourful beach tents, Lily and Tom eating ice cream with sand on their feet, the sea bright blue, Dad under a beach umbrella.
more: In July, the days are long.
In July, we swim in the sea.

words.en: We eat melon in the garden in August.
words.sz: 八月我们在花园里吃瓜。
words.scene: A hot late-summer August afternoon in the garden: Lily, Tom and Grandpa sitting at a small table under a big sun, eating slices of cold green melon, juice running down their chins, Max asleep in the shade.
more: We watch the stars in August.

words.en: Our new school year starts in September.
words.sz: 我们的新学年九月开始。
words.scene: A warm September morning at the school gate: Lily with a new school bag waving to Mum, tall green trees still in full leaf behind her, other children walking in, a round clock on the school wall.
more: In September, the evenings get dark early.
Sam starts his new school in September.

words.en: In October, the leaves turn red and brown.
words.scene: A misty October wood: tall trees with red, orange and yellow leaves, some falling in the still air, Lily and Sam walking along a wet path in warm hats and boots, grey light between the trunks.
more: We walk in the woods in October.
我们十月在树林里散步。
We have a sports day in October.

words.en: November is cold and grey.
words.scene: A cold, grey November afternoon: nearly bare trees dropping their last brown leaves in the wind, Lily in a dark coat, hat and thick scarf walking home with Mum under a streetlamp that has just come on.
more: In November, it gets dark very early.
Grandpa makes hot soup in November.

words.en: In December, the nights are long and cold.
words.sz: 十二月夜晚很长，天气很冷。
words.scene: A snowy December evening outside the house: Lily and Dad carrying a small Christmas tree in through the front door, warm light from the kitchen window, Mum and Tom waving, snow on the garden path, Max following with a paper star in his mouth.
more: December brings snow and cold nights.
十二月带来下雪和寒冷的夜晚。
Grandma sends a card in December.
奶奶十二月寄一张卡片。

words.en: We fly a kite in spring.
more: Tom rides his bike in spring.
In spring, the birds sing all day.

words.en: We eat ice cream in summer.
more: Lily swims every day in summer.
Grandma waters her plants in summer.
奶奶夏天给她的花浇水。

words.en: We collect apples in autumn.
more: Tom jumps in the leaves in autumn.
In autumn, the evenings are cool.

words.en: We learn to skate in winter.
more: Max runs in the snow in winter.
We drink hot soup in winter.

words.en: Lily has a birthday party.
words.scene: Lily's birthday party at the kitchen table: a small cake with lit candles, colourful balloons on the wall behind, Lily clapping, Tom and Mia next to her, wrapped presents in a pile beside the cake.
more: This card is for Dad's birthday.
这张卡片是给爸爸的生日的。

words.en: We don't go to school in the summer holiday.
words.scene: The family on a school-holiday morning at home: Lily on the sofa with an open book, Tom on the floor with a toy car, Max asleep between them, bright sun through the window, their bags still unpacked by the door.
more: We read ten books every holiday.
每个假期我们都读十本书。
The shops are busy in the winter holiday.

words.en: Mum has an appointment at three.
words.scene: Mum sitting on a chair in a small waiting room with a tall round clock on the wall showing three o'clock, her handbag on her knee, Dad standing by the door checking his watch.
more: Dad calls to make an appointment.
Mum is early for her appointment.

words.en: Mum has a meeting after lunch.
words.scene: Four grown-ups sitting around a table in a bright office, papers and cups on the table, Mum talking and smiling, a big window behind them.
more: Dad is at a long meeting today.
爸爸今天有一个很长的会议。
The teachers have a meeting at five o'clock.

words.en: Mum's working hours are short.
words.scene: Dad at a desk in his office with a laptop and a big round clock on the wall showing nine o'clock, the sky outside the window bright in the morning, his bag on the chair beside him.
more: The shop has long working hours in December.
这家商店十二月的工作时间很长。
